notes.Victor Wembanyama: He had 43 points and six blocks in 34 minutes Saturday and has played 34 or more in two of his last three games. Tobias Harris is out again, and Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. and Jusuf Nurkic, so the paint is wide open.
notes.Jayson Tatum: He scored 32 points and made 15 of 17 free throws in 34 minutes Sunday at Orlando, even after leaving briefly with a cut on his head. Tonight at Houston is the second night of a back-to-back, and Boston's injury report is not posted yet.
notes.Jalen Johnson: He is questionable with a left ankle sprain, and he played only 28 minutes Saturday after 34 and 36 the two games before. Kingston Flemings is suspended tonight, so if Johnson plays he carries even more of the offense at Indiana.
notes.Shai Gilgeous-Alexander: Oklahoma City is without Jalen Williams, Chet Holmgren, Cason Wallace and Alex Caruso, so almost everything runs through him. He has scored 21 to 26 points in each of his last three games while playing 28 to 31 minutes.
notes.Cooper Flagg: He had 33 points, nine rebounds and six assists in 39 minutes Friday. Kyrie Irving is questionable, Dereck Lively II is out and Santi Aldama is doubtful, so Dallas leans on him again against Sacramento.
notes.Jaylin Williams: Chet Holmgren is out, and Williams has played 26 minutes in two of his last three games off the bench. The minutes are there, but he scored just three points in 26 minutes Saturday, so his value comes from rebounds and floor time.
notes.Meleek Thomas: Jaylon Tyson is out with a right ankle sprain, and Thomas has played 19 to 23 minutes off the bench with 10 to 16 points in each of his three games.
notes.Bennett Stirtz: Alex Caruso, Cason Wallace and Jalen Williams are all out, which opens guard minutes in Oklahoma City. Stirtz has played 25 to 28 minutes in each of his last three games and scored 11 Saturday.
notes.Keldon Johnson: Tobias Harris is out with a left calf strain, and Johnson has played 22 to 24 minutes off the bench in each of his last three games. He scored only two points Saturday, so his line swings with his shot.
notes.Aday Mara: Chet Holmgren is out, and Mara played 28 minutes Saturday with seven points, nine rebounds and four blocks. He has at least two blocks in each of his last three games.
notes.Jerami Grant: Scotty Pippen Jr. is doubtful with low back soreness, and Grant has played 23 to 27 minutes off the bench in his last three games. He scored 14 points Saturday after just two the game before.
notes.Aaron Nesmith: He has started the last three games for Indiana with Tyrese Haliburton and Ivica Zubac out, and he played 30 minutes Sunday with 11 points and four assists. Tonight is the second night of a back-to-back, and Indiana's injury report is not posted yet.
Dereck Lively II is out and Santi Aldama is doubtful, so Dallas is thin up front. He has played 15 to 18 minutes off the bench in each of his last three games.
notes.Luka Doncic: He had 45 points, 15 rebounds, six assists and five steals in 35 minutes Sunday and has scored at least 37 in four straight games. Tonight against Miami is the second night of a back-to-back, and the Lakers' injury report is not posted yet.
notes.Yaxel Lendeborg: He scored a career-high 37 points in 34 minutes Sunday while Stephen Curry and Draymond Green rested on the front end of the back-to-back. If they return tonight against Phoenix, his touches should come down; Golden State's injury report is not posted yet.
notes.Brandin Podziemski: He had 17 points, eight rebounds and eight assists in 37 minutes Sunday with Stephen Curry and Draymond Green resting. If both return tonight against Phoenix his minutes and touches should come down; Golden State's report is not posted yet.
notes.Scottie Barnes: Kawhi Leonard will miss his fifth straight game tonight at the Clippers. Barnes has scored 28, 41 and 29 points in his last three games, playing 31 to 39 minutes.
notes.Franz Wagner: Paolo Banchero has missed four straight games with a high ankle sprain, and Wagner played 40 minutes Sunday with 14 points and a career-high 12 assists. Tonight is the second night of a back-to-back, and Orlando's injury report is not posted yet.
notes.Anthony Black: He has started the last two games with Jalen Suggs out and had 23 points, eight rebounds and two steals in 33 minutes Sunday against Boston.
notes.Tristan da Silva: He played 35 minutes off the bench Sunday and had 23 points and 10 rebounds with five 3-pointers. With Paolo Banchero out he plays starter minutes.
notes.Neemias Queta: He started Sunday at Orlando with Mitchell Robinson resting and played 27 minutes. Boston's report for tonight's back-to-back at Houston is not posted yet, so whether Robinson plays decides Queta's role.
notes.Mitchell Robinson: He sat out Sunday at Orlando for rest. Tonight at Houston is the second night of the back-to-back, and Boston's injury report is not posted yet.
notes.Joel Embiid: He is questionable tonight against Chicago. He had 10 points, seven rebounds and seven assists in 33 minutes Friday after 39 minutes Wednesday.
notes.Kyrie Irving: He is questionable tonight against Sacramento. He scored 35 points with nine assists in 35 minutes Friday.
notes.Coby White: He is not on Charlotte's injury report for tonight against Detroit and is expected to make his Hornets debut, likely on a minutes limit. Kon Knueppel and Grant Williams are out.
notes.Andrew Nembhard: He runs the offense with Tyrese Haliburton out and scored 23 points in 35 minutes Sunday. Indiana is on the second night of a back-to-back, and its injury report is not posted yet.
notes.Obi Toppin: He missed Friday and Sunday with a lower back injury, and Rick Carlisle said he is progressing and could play tonight against Atlanta. Indiana's injury report is not posted yet.
